title: ExternalIdentifier
description: A reference to an identifier controlled by a system outside the TIER-Graph core (a source substrate, an authority file, a domain vocabulary). It records WHICH system (`scheme`) and the opaque `value` within it. External identifiers do not confer TIER-Graph identity; they are cross-references only.

scheme.description: The identifier scheme or controlling system (e.g. 'urn:lex', 'wikidata', 'profile:<your-profile>').

value.description: The opaque identifier value within the scheme.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for display only.
